display_information.name: Consort
display_information.description: Tickets in, reviewed PRs out, questions on Slack.
display_information.long_description: Consort ships tickets with AI agents on your own machine. It DMs you a live dashboard of your tasks (also on this app's Home tab), opens a thread per ticket for progress and questions, and reads your replies in those threads. Each person runs their own consort-cli with this bot's token and their own Slack member id, so everyone sees only their own tasks.
